**Ledger check:** no Revisit date has passed yet. The next one is "Bake to order" on 2 December 2026.

## What I'd try this winter

**1. A referral offer from existing subscribers (the strongest option).** A current subscriber gives a friend 50% off their first month, and the subscriber gets a free loaf or pastry add-on. Your 6 October no-free-trial decision drops a blanket 50%-off offer, but its reopen condition is to "test it with a referral from an existing subscriber". So this is the one discount test your ledger allows. People who come through a referral are already vouched for, which should help with the low conversion you saw from the free box (6 of 52). Run it for 6–8 weeks and count how many referred signups are still paying after month two.

**2. Christmas gift subscriptions.** Sell prepaid 4-week or 8-week bread boxes as gifts, with a printed card in the first box. They're paid up front, so they fit the no-free-trial rule. December gifting is your best seasonal moment. At the end of the gift period, ask each recipient to continue at €18 a week.

**3. Winter specials that funnel into the subscription.** Offer pre-ordered seasonal bakes (a festive loaf, a stollen-style bake, a winter pastry box) under the same 6 pm cutoff, so waste stays low. Put a "get this every Saturday" card in each order.

**4. Cheap local marketing inside 3 km.** You already ride every street on Saturday. Spend about €100–150 of the €300 on doorstep cards, a poster at the shop counter and in nearby cafés or co-working spaces, and a sticker for subscribers' doors. Keep the rest for referral rewards and gift-card printing.

**Before you push any of this, check Saturday capacity.** The free box failed partly because it used Saturday slots that paying customers wanted. Work out how many extra drops the bike and team can handle, and stop each campaign when you reach that number.

## What I've left out, and why

- **Free trial or free first box:** dropped on 6 October 2026 because only 6 of 52 converted and the boxes used up Saturday slots. It reopens only if paid signups fall below 8 a month for 2 months in a row. October had 15.
- **Growing beyond 3 km with a courier:** dropped on 18 August 2026 because the cheapest quote was €4.50 a drop. It reopens at 300 subscribers.
- **Delivery apps:** dropped on 18 August 2026 because of the 30% commission and losing contact with customers. It reopens only if you open a second shop.

Tell me which of these you commit to (or drop) and I'll log it in the ledger.
